concept: CloudWatch Logs: centralized app logs, metric filters, dashboards
tests: Choosing a service for centralized search over EC2 and Lambda logs with metric filters and dashboards.
expected: Amazon CloudWatch Logs (CloudWatch agent on EC2, Lambda writes automatically) + metric filters, alarms, dashboards, Logs Insights. Triggers: "centralized, searchable application logs", "metric filters and dashboards".
why_not: CloudTrail — API activity, not application logs; S3 server access logs — S3 requests only; X-Ray — tracing, not log aggregation.
